title: Plasmodium life cycle
back: Sporozoites → liver → RBCs (haemozoin, fever every 3–4 days) → gametocytes → mosquito gut (fertilisation) → salivary glands.

title: Antibody structure
back: H₂L₂: two heavy and two light chains held by disulphide bonds; antigen-binding sites at the arm tips. IgA, IgM, IgE, IgG.

title: Bacterial, viral, protozoan
back: Typhoid (Widal test) | common cold (not the lungs) | malaria, amoebiasis. Worms: Ascaris, Wuchereria. Fungi: ringworm.

title: Innate vs acquired immunity
back: Innate barriers: physical, physiological, cellular, cytokine (interferons). Acquired: primary then stronger secondary response.

title: Active vs passive immunity
back: Active: infection, vaccine (slow, long). Passive: colostrum IgA, placenta, antitoxin (quick, short).

title: Lymphoid organs
tex: \text{primary: bone marrow, thymus}\quad\text{secondary: spleen, nodes, MALT}
back: MALT is about 50% of lymphoid tissue. The thymus is large at birth and shrinks with age.

title: HIV replication
back: Macrophage = HIV factory; helper T cells fall; opportunistic infections. Diagnosed by ELISA.

title: Benign vs malignant
back: Cancer cells lose contact inhibition. Carcinogens: X-rays, γ-rays, UV, tobacco, oncogenic viruses. α-interferon in immunotherapy.

title: Opioids, cannabinoids, cocaine
back: Heroin = diacetylmorphine (depressant); cannabinoids affect the heart and vessels; cocaine blocks dopamine transport.

title: Controlling mosquito vectors
back: Anopheles: malaria. Aedes: dengue and chikungunya. Gambusia fish eat mosquito larvae.

title: Allergy
back: Allergens: dust mites, pollen, animal dander. Relief: anti-histamines, adrenalin, steroids.
